merged_from: The refactor's documented facet-adjacency-preservation property is not exercised by any test. All new chunk_by_facet tests build criteria with a single uniform facet ('ac-text-quality'), and the pre-existing multi-facet test asserts only set-membership (sorted(flat)), not that same-facet criteria remain contiguous/grouped after balanced splitting. A regression that interleaved facets across the balanced chunk boundaries would not be caught.
